notes.title: METHODS: THE ILLUSION MURDERS is LIVE for FREE now!!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are thrilled to announce that "METHODS: THE ILLUSION MURDERS" has been [b]released on Steam for free[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636320/_/

This gripping short visual novel is now available to play for free, originally released as a DLC for the main title "Methods: The Detective Competition".



In this game, you will delve into the past of America's greatest detective - Red July, and become involved in the case that changed her life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705585/7eb718d6ca85d9cf0e2ddd3d74fb7f09124082f9.png[/img]

[b]Story:[/b]
Red July, an up-and-coming celebrity detective, is challenged by The Illusion Killer — a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions. However, in the course of solving the murder, Red July's famous method — which lets her instantly solve any crime — stops working. Now the race is on to stop the killer before it's too late!

The game is a mystery visual novel that lets you examine evidence with a short interactive puzzle mini-game.


[b]
Game Features:[/b]

· Interactive game
· Original soundtrack
· Dynamic Storytelling
· Distinctive Artwork
· Immersive Game World
· Unique DLC to Methods: The Detective Competition

We hope you enjoy this puzzling journey!

You can get the original game here with 60% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271300/Methods_The_Detective_Competition/

Till Next Time!

——LockedOn & Erabit

notes.title: "Methods: The Illusion Murders" will be launching on April 22nd！！
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting News！ 🎉

Dear Detectives,

[b]We're thrilled to announce that "Methods: The Illusion Murders" will be launching on April 22nd,[/b] diving into the mysterious cases encountered by America's greatest detective, Red July, during her younger years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705585/ab3d8bc01d5540b8f48b0646f540257899b209a5.jpg[/img]

As a prequel to the beloved Methods series, "The Illusion Murders" offers a glimpse into the early career of Red July, unravelling the enigmatic cases that shaped her journey to becoming the renowned detective we know today.

Mark your calendars for April 22nd and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of Methods like never before. "The Illusion Murders" awaits you on Steam,[b] and it's free for all to experience!
[/b]
Thank you for your unwavering support, and we can't wait to embark on this thrilling journey with you.

Till Next Time!

—— LockedOn & Erabit
